title: Pratigyabadh
desc: After her husband travels to Bombay to try to make some money in order to pay back a loan to local money-lender Lala Sukhilal, Laxmi is left lonely and apprehensive with her three children. When they fail to hear from him for months Sukhilal offers to help as long as Laxmi becomes intimate with him, but when she refuses he decides to repossess their home and belongings as repayment for the loan.

title: Jigar
desc: Duryodhan, a wrestler, is Raju's friend, but due to a misunderstanding he molests and murders his sister. Raju seeks Baba Thakur's help to train in martial arts to avenge his sister's death.

title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
desc: Mala is a poor girl who marries into a wealthy family at the behest of a patriarch. However, after his death, she must deal with abusive relatives and yet strive to restore harmony in the family.

title: Santosh
desc: A wealthy woman falls in love with a poor man, whom she marries and has a child with, but soon she longs for her old life and abandons both her husband and son. She remarries a rich man, with whom she has another son. Years later, the two boys find themselves on opposite sides of a struggle.
